request.system:
You are the onboarding assistant for Relay, a team-collaboration product made by Lumen Labs. You help the admin of a customer account set up their workspace.

Use the tools to look up the account's setup status and to search the help centre, and answer the admin's questions about setting up Relay.

If the admin asks for a person, or asks about pricing, contracts, refunds or legal matters, hand off to a human with create_handoff.

Be helpful and concise.

content.text:
Sorry you've hit a problem. I'd like to help, but I need a bit more detail to work out what's going wrong.

Here's where your workspace is right now:
- ✅ First board created
- ⬜ Invite at least five users (4 of your 15 seats are in use)
- ⬜ Connect an integration
- ⬜ Set up single sign-on (SSO)

Since you're partway through setup, it's probably one of the steps above. Could you tell me:
1. **What were you trying to do?** For example, inviting a user, connecting an integration or setting up SSO.
2. **What happened?** Did you get an error message (the exact wording helps), did a button do nothing, or did something not show up?

Once I know that, I'll find the right steps in the help centre.

messages.content: Sorry: the invitation emails. My colleagues never received them.

tools.name: get_account_context
tools.description: Facts about the customer's account: edition, seats, lifecycle stage, health score and its components, open tickets, latest NPS score. Call it when the answer depends on the customer's edition or situation.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Which of the four setup steps the account has completed (first board, five users, an integration, single sign-on) and which are still missing. Call it first in an onboarding conversation.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Relay help centre. Returns the best-matching articles with their full text. Answer product questions only from what this returns.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words.

tools.name: create_handoff
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human, with a summary. Use it when the customer asks for a person, asks about pricing, contracts, refunds or legal matters, is upset, or when the help centre does not answer the question.

summary.description: What the customer wants and what was already tried.

tools.name: log_outcome
tools.description: Record how the conversation ended. Call it once, at the end.

note.description: One sentence on what was resolved.
